title: Operations Shell Heading And Label Cleanup

reasons: The operator asked to fix broad One Time UI mistakes and make the project clean, even, and loading nicely.
The July 1 current-state visual audit already identified repeated Operations shell heading and label findings across Rabbi-scoped routes.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Deploy/live-smoke proof may require the current Railway target.
External email, Stripe, DNS, WhatsApp, Vimeo, Zoom, and access-grant work is outside this packet.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this shell slice, select brand/IA or role-scope cleanup using the latest after-audit evidence.

operator_intent_summary: Make obvious Rabbi / One Time UI mistakes cleaner and more even before manual project review, starting with repeated audit-backed Operations shell defects.

decisions_captured.decision: GHL-like or CRM cleanup language means first-party BNA Operations patterns only.

out_of_scope: No whole-project redesign in this packet.
No content-library restructuring beyond common shell effects.

No email sends, WhatsApp sends, Stripe charges, access grants, DNS changes, Vimeo/Zoom writes, GHL runtime, LeadConnector references, external CRM writes, hard deletes, secret exposure, or raw private evidence.

inspection_targets: July 1 audit findings VQF-001 through VQF-020 and repeated VQ-A11Y-006 findings
known_blockers: Deploy/live-smoke target may be unavailable in this local turn.
Broader CRM/community redesign remains blocked until route-specific implementation packets pass Definition of Ready.

expanded_phrases.fix everything: Work the broad UI correction through a Packet DAG and close each focused requirement with evidence or blockers instead of one unbounded edit.
expanded_phrases.even: Common shell layout should have stable, aligned route heading hierarchy, consistent topbar labels, and no repeated false-positive accessibility findings across every route.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The route should present a clear page purpose as soon as the shell renders; loading/error/permission states remain explicit and not confused with missing headings.
expanded_phrases.clean: Readable semantic heading, labeled controls, no support/debug clutter in normal Rabbi flow, no hidden-control false positives, responsive verification, and screenshot evidence.
expanded_phrases.CRM: In this packet, CRM means first-party BNA Operations contact and workflow patterns only; no GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM runtime, or external CRM writes.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: This packet improves the shared first-party BNA Operations shell while keeping One Time data and provider workflow scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix the repeated Operations shell route-heading and form-label findings for Rabbi-scoped routes.
requirements.expected_result: The common shell renders a stable route-level heading and the audit counts only visible unlabeled controls, with shared controls named accessibly.
acceptance_criteria: A visible or programmatic h1 exists for the active Operations route.
Topbar workspace/status/helper controls have accessible names.
The Rabbi current-state audit ignores hidden inputs/selects/textareas when counting unlabeled controls.
No GHL runtime, external CRM, send, payment, DNS, access-grant, Vimeo, Zoom, or secret behavior is introduced.
Focused validation and an after-audit report or exact blocker are recorded.

criteria: VQ findings are mapped: VQ-IA-006, VQ-A11Y-007, and VQ-A11Y-006.
Affected route list is exact and limited to Rabbi-scoped Operations shell routes.
Allowed implementation files are public/operations.html and scripts/audit-rabbi-onetime-current-state.mjs.
External/provider writes are out of scope.
App-visible closeout requires deploy/live smoke or exact blocker.

loading.expected_visible_message: The shell shows workspace/module/section before records finish loading.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Exactly one route-level h1 names the current section.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Shared topbar controls have accessible names.

empty.expected_visible_title: One Time Mishnah Class / Participants / Members / Participants
empty.expected_visible_message: No provider participants or contacts are loaded yet.

empty.test_smoke_assertion: No unlabeled visible form controls are counted from hidden modals.

populated.expected_visible_title: One Time Mishnah Class / Content / One Time Library
populated.expected_visible_message: Library records sit below a clear shell heading.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: The h1 precedes library sections in reading order.
populated.accessibility_expectation: No hidden modal controls are treated as visible unlabeled controls.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: state.has_h1 is true and inputs_without_labels excludes hidden controls.

error.expected_visible_title: One Time Mishnah Class / Communications / Providers

error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error banner is after a stable h1.

blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: No external write action is enabled by this packet.

findings.user_impact: The user and assistive technology cannot identify the screen purpose from a stable page heading.
findings.expected_fix: Add one clear route-level heading that matches the user mental model for this surface.

findings.user_impact: Visible form controls must have labels; hidden modal controls should not create route-wide false positives.
findings.expected_fix: Name shared controls and update the audit to count visible form controls only.
